WHEREAS
(A)

The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled “DOWNTOWN RUMANZA”, comprising inter alia
residential apartments, service apartments, shops, hotel apartments and food courts located at Plot No. RC-01A,
Near Rumanza Golf Course, DHA Multan (“Project”);

(B)

The Buyer is desirous to purchase the commercial shop as described in the Description of Purchased Unit (“Purchased
Unit”); and

(C)

The Developer has agreed to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and to take on lease the same from the Buyer, on the
terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions:

SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION
1.

For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase
Price, the Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased
Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest of the Developer therein, strictly in accordance with
the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from
time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the
persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several.

2.

The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement
between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale, purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral
part of this Agreement to Sell (the “Agreement”):
(i)

Description of Purchased Unit;

(ii)

This Agreement to Sell;

(iii)

Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit & Nominees Form;

(iv)

Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions;

(v)

Appendix A: Payment Plan;

(vi)

Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan;

(vii) Appendix C: List of Materials;
(viii) Appendix D: Criteria and Schedule for Monthly Payments; and
(ix) Any other document incorporated by reference in this Agreement.
3.

The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict,
ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions,
followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the
meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General

Buyer’s initials

Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement.

BUYER’S WARRANTIES
4.

The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further
terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer.

5.

The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all
respects.

6.

The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the
requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder.

ARBITRATION
7.

Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising
thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual
agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

SCHEDULE B

GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1.

DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
1.1.

Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below:

Agreement

means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all
documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell.

Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which
these General Terms and Conditions are appended.
Adjusted Amount

has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions.

Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her
or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees
and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer
shall be to such persons jointly and severally.
Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit
and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Units,
including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system,
lobbies, Parking Space and hallways.
Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup
equipment, security systems, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets
of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of
Purchased Units and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit.
Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department,
local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority including, inter alia, the Defence Housing
Authority, Lahore- Multan Chapter and any other authority which has jurisdiction over
any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement.
Completion Date or Estimated
Completion Date has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 5.1 of these General Terms and Conditions.
Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion
Date.

has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 15.1 of these General Terms and Conditions.

Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/

Sell and/or with respect to the Purchased Unit, to the Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of
the demise of the Buyer.
